title: Program Status Rules: Holds, Resumption and Administrative Closure (Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program)
content:
**Placing a hold.** An active Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program is placed on hold for exactly one recorded reason, and only for a reason that is true on the date of the write.

| Hold reason | True when |
|---|---|
| inpatient stay | the customer or caregiver reports a current inpatient admission to a hospital or skilled nursing facility, on tiers where shipments are held during an inpatient stay (the report is the caller's statement) |
| coverage lapse | the coverage record the program bills has a termination date earlier than the date of the write and no other in-effect coverage on file fixes the program's tier |
| documentation lapse | no authorization grant of the program is valid on the date of the write |
| past-due balance | on tiers whose past-due age is greater than 0, the program's past-due amount is at least the tier's past-due hold amount and no approved payment plan covers it |
| customer request | the customer asks to pause shipments |

The past-due amount is the greater of 0.00 and the patient-balance postings (remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds) posted more than the tier's past-due age in calendar days before the test date, less all payments and balance adjustments posted on or before the test date, applied to the oldest postings first.

**Resuming.** A program on hold resumes only when its recorded hold reason has cleared:

| Hold reason | Cleared by |
|---|---|
| inpatient stay | discharge reported |
| coverage lapse | an in-effect coverage on file and written onto the program |
| documentation lapse | an authorization grant valid on the date of the write |
| past-due balance | a past-due amount below the tier's past-due hold amount, or an approved payment plan |
| customer request | the customer's own request |

**Administrative closure.** A program closes administratively, with the matching closure reason, in exactly these cases:

| Closure reason | Case |
|---|---|
| documentation not received | a program still in referral received or pending authorization once the date of the write is later than the enrolled date plus the tier's referral documentation window in calendar days, with no prior authorization decision pending |
| authorization denied | a payer prior authorization denial stands and no new request is pending |
| hold limit reached | a program on hold once the date of the write is later than the hold start date plus the tier's longest hold in calendar days |
| coverage ended | a program on hold for coverage lapse whose customer reports no replacement coverage |
| customer discontinued | the customer confirms the cancellation of a program on hold |
| deceased | Larkfield's records team has recorded the customer's death |

**Day counts.** Day counts in these rules are calendar days counted from the named date, and a closure is made only on a day strictly later than the named date plus the stated days.

**Both sides of a limit (hypothetical).** A hold started on day 0 on a tier with a 60-day longest hold: on day 60 the program may not be closed for the hold limit; on day 61 it may. A program enrolled on day 0 with a 30-day referral window and no decision pending: day 30 is too early; day 31 allows closure for documentation not received.
